description: Titus, no name of a part

participation.context: Played, and brought no part-name away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: The name is his, from last night. He is not on this plot.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: They had the name by this afternoon.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

story.body: You read the title and the hour. You did not give the side a name. The name Kemp tried last night was already in the house.

title: Played Titus
